title: Departures (2023)
description:
"Departures" is the seventh experimental electroambient full album by Runaway Horses. It heavily relies on tape machines, microbeats, tiny synthetized percussions, warm synths and field recordings. I also recorded vocal parts for some tracks. The album will be soon available on every store and streaming platform. It's also available for purchase on Bandcamp.
Genre: experimental electroambient
Artist: Runaway Horses
Released on: 11th Jan 2023 © Runaway Horses
